response.sql:
WITH PlaylistCounts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) as TrackCount
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
AverageCount AS (
  SELECT AVG(TrackCount) as AvgTrackCount
  FROM PlaylistCounts
)
SELECT 
  pc.PlaylistId,
  pc.TrackCount,
  pc.TrackCount / ac.AvgTrackCount as Ratio
FROM PlaylistCounts pc
CROSS JOIN AverageCount ac
ORDER BY Ratio IS NULL, Ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Include all playlists from the Playlist table in the average calculation, even those with zero tracks (via LEFT JOIN on PlaylistTrack). This means the average denominator includes empty playlists.

alternatives.interpretation: Only consider playlists that have at least one track; calculate the average only over non-empty playlists (exclude zero-track playlists from both the results and the average denominator).

  pc.TrackCount / ac.AvgTrackCount as Ratio
FROM PlaylistCounts pc
CROSS JOIN AverageCount ac
ORDER BY Ratio IS NULL, Ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
